entities.summary: Hisanori Fujita  was a Japanese admiral in the Imperial Japanese Navy, court official and Shinto priest. After retiring from active service, he served as Chief Priest of Meiji Shrine and the Grand Chamberlain to emperor Hirohito during World War II.
